description: Capitalization rate = net operating income ÷ value. NOI is potential gross income minus vacancy and credit loss minus operating expenses. Mortgage, depreciation, income tax and capital expenditures are not subtracted. You can also omit value and give a target cap rate to back into value. Educational only, not appraisal or investment advice.

operating_expenses.description: Annual operating expenses, excluding debt service

potential_gross_income.description: Annual scheduled rent plus other income

target_cap_rate_percent.description: If value is omitted, value = NOI ÷ (target / 100)

vacancy_percent.description: Vacancy and credit loss as a percent of PGI, 0–100

value.description: Purchase price or current market value

name: cap_rate
title: Real-estate cap rate from NOI and value
